lines.text: Hallelujah!
Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good;
His loving devotion endures forever.
Who can describe the mighty acts of the LORD
or fully proclaim His praise?
Blessed are those who uphold justice,
who practice righteousness at all times.
Remember me, O LORD, in Your favor to Your people;
visit me with Your salvation,
that I may see the prosperity of Your chosen ones,
and rejoice in the gladness of Your nation,
and give glory with Your inheritance.
We have sinned like our fathers;
we have done wrong and acted wickedly.
Our fathers in Egypt did not grasp Your wonders
or remember Your abundant kindness;
but they rebelled by the sea,
there at the Red Sea.
Yet He saved them for the sake of His name,
to make His power known.
He rebuked the Red Sea, and it dried up;
He led them through the depths as through a desert.
He saved them from the hand that hated them;
He redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
The waters covered their foes;
not one of them remained.
Then they believed His promises
and sang His praise.

pictures.name: pd_gelder_simeon

pictures.scene: Vasily Polenov, Moscow Courtyard — the ordinary yard with its children and its church in the morning sun, remember me, O LORD, in Your favor to Your people
pictures.name: pd_polenov_dvorik

pictures.scene: Pieter Bruegel the Elder, The Peasant Wedding — the whole village crowded in to eat and drink together, that I may rejoice in the gladness of Your nation
pictures.name: pd_bruegel_bruiloft

pictures.scene: Georges de La Tour, Magdalen with the Smoking Flame — the penitent sitting alone with the skull and the one small flame, we have sinned like our fathers
pictures.name: pd_latour_magdalena

pictures.scene: Hans Jordaens III, The Crossing of the Red Sea — the multitude massed on the shore under a black sky with the horsemen coming on, our fathers in Egypt did not grasp Your wonders and they rebelled by the sea
pictures.name: pd_jordaens_oever

pictures.scene: Vincent Malo, Moses parting the Red Sea — the rod held out over the water and the sea standing back, to make His power known as He led them through the depths as through a desert
pictures.name: pd_malo_rodezee

pictures.scene: Paolo Veronese, The Finding of Moses — the crowned princess and her women receiving the child at the riverside, He saved them from the hand that hated them
pictures.name: pd_veronese_mozes

pictures.scene: John Martin, The Destruction of Pharaoh's Host — the surf closing over the chariots under the red sun, not one of them remained, and there on the shore they believed His promises and sang His praise
